description: This file defines a utility object 'SplitUtils' that provides a function to split a string into tokens and store them in a custom linked list. It also includes internal functions to validate tokens before adding them to the list.

classes.name: SplitUtils
classes.description: An object providing string splitting utility functions.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits the input string into tokens separated by spaces and returns them as a LinkedList.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds a token to the list if it is valid (non-empty).

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks whether a token is valid (non-empty).
